def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    two_rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[i])]
    two_cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(h))]
    obj=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,2)]
    vals={(i,j):g[i][j] for i,j in obj}
    for i,j in obj: g[i][j]=bg
    if two_rows:
        t=two_rows[0]
        if min(i for i,_ in obj)>t:   # object below line
            dy=(t+1)-min(i for i,_ in obj)
            for (i,j),v in vals.items(): g[i+dy][j]=v
            r8=max(i for i,_ in obj)+dy+1
            g[r8]=[8]*w
        else:                          # object above line
            dy=(t-1)-max(i for i,_ in obj)
            for (i,j),v in vals.items(): g[i+dy][j]=v
            r8=min(i for i,_ in obj)+dy-1
            g[r8]=[8]*w
    else:
        t=two_cols[0]
        if min(j for _,j in obj)>t:   # object right of line
            dx=(t+1)-min(j for _,j in obj)
            for (i,j),v in vals.items(): g[i][j+dx]=v
            c8=max(j for _,j in obj)+dx+1
            for i in range(h): g[i][c8]=8
        else:                          # object left of line
            dx=(t-1)-max(j for _,j in obj)
            for (i,j),v in vals.items(): g[i][j+dx]=v
